# Exemptions for scripts/privacy-guard.mjs. A pull request that changes this file is
# flagged in its log, and the file is control plane: read every line it adds.
#
#   email <domain-or-address>     an address, or a domain and its subdomains
#   path <glob> <rule,rule | *>   the named rules are not applied to matching files
#
# Rules: private-ip, session-id, tailnet-name, internal-host, private-repo, email,
# owner-quote, new-file.

# Reserved example domains. Tests and docs use them.
email example.com
email example.org
email example.net
email example.test
email example.invalid

# Test fixtures hold planted bad values on purpose.
path **/fixtures/** *

# The guard's own host list. Those names are already public; the list is the rule.
path scripts/privacy-guard.mjs internal-host

# docs/claude-home/ mirrors the owner's rules, and the rules carry dated owner quotes.
# Plan row 1.30c moves the mirror to the private ops repository, and this line goes with it.
path docs/claude-home/** owner-quote
